title: OPS-DASH-2: /ops shows cost, criticality k and clocks beside the agents
body:
**Owner:** Product manager
**Trigger:** CONTROL-PLANE-1 live
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/controlplane.js::k_eff
**Status:** open

The operations dashboard shows agents, in-progress, waiting, on-deck and findings from D1. It does not yet show the money side or the clocks: criticality_samples (k_eff), cost_samples against instances/ultrastable/cost-budgets.json, and the sweeper open-loop age. Add them as tiles and findings (k below floor, cost over budget, open_loop_age_hours over 0) and to GET /api/v1/status. Closing probe: /api/v1/status has k_eff and cost fields and /ops renders them.
